ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Run Key from Download
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the suspicious RUN keys created by software located in Download or temporary Outlook/Internet Explorer directories

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Packages\\\\Microsoft\\\.Outlook\\_.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Olk\\\\Attachments\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet\\ Files\\\\Content\\\.Outlook\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Local\\ Settings\\\\Temporary\\ Internet\\ Files\\\\.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run.*")))
